one_liner: ecommerce platform with Admin and Storefront APIs to build apps, manage store data.
access_notes: You can self‑serve dev credentials and install on development stores, but public distribution across multiple merchants requires Shopify’s app review and approval.
mcp_notes: Shop MCP (buyer-side, hosted at mcp.shop.com) is available; a separate “Shopify MCP” for merchant‑side Admin actions is announced as “coming soon” in docs.
blocker_notes: Public distribution needs review; some scopes (e.g., protected customer data) need separate approval; Admin APIs are rate‑limited; REST Admin API is legacy (GraphQL required for new public apps as of Apr 1, 2025).
